acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for historic window trim restoration, look for a company with demonstrated experience in historic preservation and an understanding of traditional building materials and techniques. Review their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references. It's also important to choose a contractor familiar with the architectural styles prevalent in areas like the East End or North End of Boise.
